name: n8n-nodes-getmulticast
description: n8n community node for GetMulticast — generate AI videos, publish posts, manage AI-drafted replies, and configure webhooks/RSS feeds across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and Google Business. Includes a real Trigger node with automatic webhook lifecycle management.

scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p dist/nodes/GetMulticast dist/nodes/GetMulticastTrigger && cp nodes/GetMulticast/getmulticast.svg dist/nodes/GetMulticast/ && cp nodes/GetMulticastTrigger/getmulticast.svg dist/nodes/GetMulticastTrigger/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run lint
